claims.statement: Carrier Operations confirms that slot corrections must be targeted to the identified carrier feed and its specific lag after diagnosis, and must precede any replay of allocations
claims.limitation: Previous slot correction failed because the affected feed was not identified. Carrier Ops requires feed identification before applying correction.

claims.statement: The 186 held orders require: (1) feed identification, (2) targeted slot correction to that feed, (3) replay of allocations. The root cause is preventable (v17 restore), but remediation requires Carrier Ops coordination.
claims.limitation: Remediation authority limited to read-only diagnostics and single reversible action; Carrier Ops slot correction is outside incident assessment scope.

next_action.rationale: Carrier Operations requires identification of the specific carrier feed whose 47-minute confirmation lag exceeds the 30-minute slot window. Reading partition offsets will show the carrier feed topology and lag characteristics, enabling targeted slot correction. This diagnostic is final step to enable remediation: identify feed -> report to Carrier Ops for slot correction -> resume replay.
